verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no batch or bulk-operation capability, either as a batch endpoint or as multi-select actions in the app. The API is per-task: you submit one request and poll one task id. 'Parallel generations: 20' is a concurrency limit, and 'run the same prompt across models' is model comparison; both are adjacent features, not bulk operations across many items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
